title: Senior Accountant
description: ABOUT US At TOPPAN Security, our mission is to shape a meaningful, technology-driven future by being a global leader in mission-critical identity and payment technologies. We serve as the international development arm of the TOPPAN Group in the security domain, founded in 1900. TOPPAN is a trusted Japanese brand renowned for its commitment to exceptional quality. Building on this legacy, we combine bold ideas, deep sector expertise, and collaborative intelligence to deliver secure, future-ready solutions. Our culture is grounded in four core values: Agility , Ownership , Resilience , and a Sense of Fun . We move fast, lead with accountability, grow through challenges, and bring positive energy into everything we do. Join us and be part of a global, collaborative team where trust and innovation drive everything we do. About the role and what you'll do The Finance Manager plays a key role in ensuring accurate financial reporting, strong financial controls, regulatory compliance, and effective financial management. Working closely with the CFO, Finance team, and wider organisation, you will provide financial insight, support business decisions, and contribute to continuous improvement. · Prepare and analyse financial statements, management reports, reconciliations, and cash flow reports · Oversee general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, and the accuracy of financial records · Analyse financial performance, investigate variances, and provide insights and recommendations to management · Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning, including identifying opportunities for cost control · Coordinate and support internal and external audits and ensure timely and accurate documentation · Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory requirements, and internal policies · Prepare and support tax filings, working with external advisors where required · Provide financial analysis and guidance to support business and strategic decisions · Collaborate with senior management and cross-functional teams on financial matters · Mentor junior accounting team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of Finance processes and controls About you Experience and knowledge · Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field · Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent is an advantage · 10+ years' relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a senior accounting or financial management role · Strong experience in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and general ledger management · Good understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, tax, audit, and statutory compliance · Experience managing AP/AR, reconciliations, cash flow, and financial records · Experience supporting audits and working with senior management and external stakeholders · Previous experience leading or mentoring Finance or accounting team members · Strong Excel and financial systems/ERP skills · Excellent written and spoken English Skills & Competencies · Financial Reporting & Financial Management · Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Analysis · Audit, Tax & Regulatory Compliance · Financial Controls & Corporate Governance · Strategic Financial Planning & Decision Support · Leadership & Team Development · Stakeholder Management & Communication · Problem Solving & Attention to Detail · Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Location, travel and eligibility · Based in Ethiopia Ready to take the next step? Join a global, collaborative, and fast-moving environment where people, trust, and innovation matter. We'd love to hear from you 😉 TOPPAN Security is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, sexual orientation, age, colour, religion, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

title: Manager - Portfolio Analytics
description: About Inkomoko Inkomoko supports entrepreneurs to grow their businesses in order to improve livelihoods, create jobs, and help communities thrive. In 2026, Inkomoko was listed by the Financial Times as the 5th fastest-growing company in Africa, supporting entrepreneurs across East and Central Africa to grow thriving businesses and build inclusive, resilient economies. Founded in 2012, Inkomoko has worked with more than 100,000 entrepreneurs, including thousands of refugee entrepreneurs. Inkomoko provides a combination of training, consulting, access to finance, and market-level systems change. We are the largest investor to refugee entrepreneurs in Africa. Inkomoko has 1000+ staff in 50 offices across Chad, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, and South Sudan. Through Inkomoko's 2030 strategic plan, we are adding 3 additional countries to serve more than 550,000 entrepreneurs and growing our $30M loan fund to impact 7M lives. INKOMOKO VALUES All staff at Inkomoko are connected to a shared set of organizational values: Purpose:be solutions-oriented, produce high-quality work, be a global leader Achievement: push yourself to reach beyond what you previously thought possible. Improvement: be humble, engage in continuous growth through open & accurate feedback Bravery: willing to take risks, create a safe space for others, be compassionate, inclusive We Eat Goat: we celebrate success and support each other in hard times. We do this work together in the spirit of turikumwe, tuko pamoja, abren nen, urang babarengan Inkomoko is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer. Refugees, women, and persons who reflect the diverse communities we serve are strongly encouraged to apply. About The Opportunity And Responsibilities As the Manager, Portfolio Analytics, you will lead a team of Investments Business Analysts and Graduate Trainees to drive data-informed investment decisions, strengthen portfolio performance and risk monitoring, and lead strategic investment systems and analytics initiatives. In this role, you will provide analytical oversight and decision support for credit risk management, strengthen portfolio and financial data architecture, and own executive-level portfolio reporting. You will serve as a strategic partner to cross-functional and cross-country leaders, translating complex data into actionable insights that improve investment decisions and portfolio outcomes. You will also lead core digital transformation initiatives to streamline data flows between investment operational and accounting systems, strengthen data quality and governance, and improve operational efficiency, portfolio visibility and portfolio quality across Inkomoko. Roles And Responsibilities Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing team of Business Analysts and Graduate Trainees, setting clear objectives, performance standards and development plans while building a culture of analytical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement Portfolio Performance Analytics: Lead analysis of portfolio performance across key indicators including disbursements, collections, PAR, defaults, write-offs, recoveries, and provisioning. Identify performance trends, drivers, risks and opportunities, and translate findings into actionable recommendations Portfolio Planning, Forecasting & Scenario Analysis: Support portfolio forecasting, target setting and scenario modelling to support portfolio growth.Provide forward-looking assessments of expected portfolio performance under different business and risk scenarios Risk Analytics & Early Warning: Develop and maintain portfolio risk monitoring and early-warning indicators to identify emerging deterioration, concentration risks and other changes in portfolio quality. Lead stress testing and scenario analysis and provide timely escalation of material risks Credit & Investment Decision Support: Provide timely, high-quality analytical support to Portfolio and Credit Risk Management, using data and insights to inform underwriting, client selection, portfolio growth, collections, risk mitigation and other investment decisions Executive Reporting & Insights: Own internal and external executive-level reporting on portfolio investments, ensuring executive leadership, Board members, country leadership and external partners receive accurate, timely and insightful reporting. Translate complex portfolio data into clear conclusions, forward-looking insights and actionable recommendations Business Intelligence & Reporting: Design, develop and maintain automated dashboards, analytical tools and reporting solutions that provide accessible, reliable and timely visibility into portfolio performance, risk and strategic KPIs Data & Systems Transformation: Support the DT team on data and systems change initiatives that strengthen credit risk infrastructure, data integration, portfolio analytics and reporting automation. title: Enterprise Resource Planning Solution Architect
description: Company Description Beryl Davis Ltd is a growing professional services and technology firm focused on helping organizations optimize their core business operations. The company partners with clients to design, implement, and support enterprise solutions that enhance efficiency, transparency, and decision-making. Working across diverse industries, Beryl Davis Ltd emphasizes collaboration, structured methodologies, and measurable outcomes. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, improve processes, and develop their skills in a supportive and results-oriented environment. Role Description The Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Solution Architect will lead the design, configuration, and optimization of ERP solutions for clients, ensuring alignment with business objectives and processes. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing current and target business processes, developing solution architectures, defining integration points with other enterprise systems, and creating technical and functional documentation. The role involves working closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, translating them into system designs, guiding implementation teams, and overseeing system testing and validation. The ERP Solution Architect will also provide ongoing support, recommend enhancements, and contribute to ERP roadmap planning and governance. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Qualifications Ability to analyze and optimize Business Process workflows, including requirements gathering and process mapping. Strong Solution Architecture skills with experience in designing end-to-end ERP solutions and integration patterns. Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and principles, ensuring alignment between business, data, application, and technology layers. Hands-on experience with Enterprise Software platforms and understanding of their deployment, configuration, and support. Proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, including module configuration, customization, and best practices. Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is an advantage. Experience leading ERP implementation or upgrade projects, preferably in a consulting or systems integrator environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and present complex concepts clearly. Ability to work on-site in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, collaborate in multidisciplinary teams, and support multiple projects concurrently. Relevant professional certifications in ERP platforms or architecture (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, TOGAF) are beneficial.
